title: Recipient holds and rebinds
description: Per-UEI policy input read by code/cedar_publication.recipient_holds(). An entry states that the recipient behind an exact UEI, on exact award keys, is a legal entity distinct from the Cedar entity the projection currently binds it to (withhold), or is a different registered Cedar entity (rebind). It is not a not_native denial and may never say so. The hand validator in cedar_publication.validate_recipient_holds() is the enforced rule; this schema documents the same shape. Written 2026-10-02 for the Siletz repair.

hold_id.description: The hold record's own id (what). Never a CE- or CB- id.

collection.description: The collection id the scoped transactions belong to, e.g. funding.

recipient_uei.description: The exact SAM UEI the hold scopes to. A dated attribute of the recipient, not an identity.

award_ids.description: Exact award keys (USAspending generated unique award id or the collection's award key). A (recipient_uei, award_id) pair is scoped by at most one entry.

action.description: withhold pairs with distinct_recipient and writes attribution_status withheld_distinct_recipient; rebind pairs with rebind_to_entity and moves the binding to correct_recipient.cedar_uid.

bound_cedar_uid.description: The uid the projection currently carries on the scoped transactions, read off the projection, never inferred from the register. null only while status is evidence_incomplete.

correct_recipient.description: Who the recipient is. For a withhold the uid is null (the recipient is not in the register, or is not asserted); for a rebind it is a uid the register already holds. A hold never mints.

ruling.description: The fact the hold states, in the owner's or reviewer's words. May not say not_native: that vocabulary belongs to the ruling ledger and means something else.

status.description: evidence_incomplete: recorded, not applicable yet (bound_cedar_uid may be null). ready: every field present; the producer rebuild may consume it. applied: consumed by a pinned release; keep the entry, it is the record.

owner_review.description: Who reviews the entry (AGENTS.md section 5: Havala Hanson for Press data; identity questions to Elijah Moreno through her).
